# Class: ProcessHandle

Defined in: [src/specification/facets/\_common/process.ts:22](https://github.com/jterrazz/package-test/blob/main/src/specification/facets/_common/process.ts#L22)

An external process, declared like any other service.

Before this there were three shapes for the same thing: `website({ server })`
took a `ServeOptions`, a literate document took a `serve:` entry, and a
project that needed a second process — an API behind the site, Metro behind
the simulator — started one by hand in a `beforeAll` and killed it in an
`afterAll` it sometimes forgot. `process()` is the one shape, and the
framework owns the lifetime.

It sits in a `services` record beside `postgres()`, `redis()` and
`sqlite()`, so it starts after them and can be handed their connection
strings through `env`, and it is stopped with the specification.

### composeName

```ts
composeName: string | null = null;
```

Defined in: [src/specification/facets/\_common/process.ts:29](https://github.com/jterrazz/package-test/blob/main/src/specification/facets/_common/process.ts#L29)

Compose service name. Left `null` until the orchestrator binds it at
start time (CONVENTIONS A6): a handle with no explicit `composeService`
links to the compose service named exactly like its record key, else the
kebab-case conversion of the key — so `{ analyticsDb: postgres() }` binds
to the compose service `analytics-db` without any option. Set
`composeService` explicitly only for names the key cannot derive.

### isolation()

```ts
isolation(): IsolationStrategy;
```

Defined in: [src/specification/facets/\_common/process.ts:71](https://github.com/jterrazz/package-test/blob/main/src/specification/facets/_common/process.ts#L71)

Isolation is the RUN's, not the worker's — and a run here is one
EVALUATION of the specification module. Under vitest's default
isolation that is once per test file, so two files that import the same
specification get a child each, with the id the facet minted for it.
Nothing is acquired or reset between tests: the id is what tells two
runs apart, never a label a spec samples.

#### Returns

[`IsolationStrategy`](../type-aliases/IsolationStrategy.md)

```ts
ServiceHandle.isolation
```
